snapshot.mastery_depth: UPSC IR 1: Foreign Policy & Neighbourhood is a daily exam-learning block, not just a list of facts. Read each point for definition, example, and common trap. Guiral Doctrine: Non-reciprocity with smaller neighbors. Foundation of modern neighborhood policy. Neighbourhood First: Priority to immediate neighbors. SAARC (stagnant), whereas BIMSTEC (rising). Connectivity (BBIN). Act East Policy: Evolution of "Look East". Focus on ASEAN + Japan/South Korea. Security, Connectivity, Culture. Connect Central Asia: Instinctive interest in energy-rich region. INSTC corridor. Chabahar port (Iran). Soft Power: Yoga, Diaspora, IT, Buddhism, Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR). Before attempting the quiz, be able to explain each term in one sentence and match it with its law, convention, example, or exam keyword.
